estimate_notice: All prices shown are labelled estimates, not real quotes.
hero_headline: Plan Your Perfect Event with AI
hero_subline: From dream wedding to community festival — get a complete budget, timeline, vendor checklist, and creative ideas in seconds.
card_wedding_desc: Multi-tier ceremony, sangeet, and reception planning with heritage venue coordination and traditional catering management.
card_birthday_desc: Theme-driven parties with age-appropriate activities, entertainment booking, and personalized guest experiences.
card_community_desc: Festival coordination with volunteer management, permit logistics, stage setup, and community dining arrangements.
how_subtitle: Three simple steps to your complete event plan.
step1_desc: Choose your event type, set your budget, pick a date, and share your vision.
step2_desc: Our engine creates a verified budget, scheduled timeline, vendor checklist, and creative ideas.
step3_desc: Explore your plan across four detailed tabs. Adjust inputs and regenerate anytime.
cta_subtitle: Join thousands of planners who trust AI-powered event management. Completely free.
footer_disclaimer: All budget figures are benchmark estimates. Indic language translations are in Beta.
planner_help_event_type: Select wedding, birthday, or community event to configure budget benchmarks.
planner_help_date: Your event date. Milestones are backward-scheduled from this day.
planner_help_guests: Expected attendees for venue and catering sizing.
planner_help_budget: Total funds in your chosen currency. Lines will sum to exactly 100%.
planner_help_city: City or region for vendor pricing recommendations.
planner_help_language: Output language for the plan. Indic languages are in Beta.
planner_help_vibe: Describe the mood, style, or theme you envision.
planner_help_notes: Dietary needs, traditions, accessibility requirements, or priorities.
result_benchmark: Benchmark Plan: AI service is busy, showing a benchmark plan. Try again later or add your own key in the sidebar.
result_budget_verified: Budget Integrity Verified: Lines sum exactly to 100%.
byok_caption: Optional: Use your own free API keys. Keys stay in session memory only.
estimates_disclaimer: Estimates Only: All budget allocations and prices are benchmark estimates, not contractual quotes.
